description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
